$comment: Discovery document for agents. Not a standardised path (WebMCP and MCP are still settling), so treat this as malipetek.dev's own manifest and prefer /llms.txt + /agents for the human-readable version. The knowledgebase has its own server at https://lab.malipetek.dev/mcp.
name: malipetek.dev client portal
description: The malipetek.dev client portal over MCP: file and follow website requests on a client's own account. Every request still waits for Ali before work starts.

client.note: Client agent keys are minted and revoked in the portal. OAuth is also supported at /oauth/authorize.

webmcp.note: The contracting site registers an in-page open_intercom tool via document.modelContext when the browser implements WebMCP. The knowledgebase tools live on lab.malipetek.dev.

knowledgebase.note: Ali's agentic coding knowledgebase, open-source plugins and writing are a separate site. Nothing there is part of the client portal.
